questions.prompt: What is the best mental model for reading a Rust lifetime parameter 'a?

options.a: A region of code during which the reference must remain valid

questions.prompt: Why does the function longer<'a>(a: &'a str, b: &'a str) -> &'a str require explicit lifetime annotations?

options.a: It is a mandatory style convention for all string functions
options.b: With two input references, the compiler cannot infer which input the output borrows from — the annotation states the contract
options.c: Every function in Rust requires a lifetime parameter
